description: Connect to a Q-SYS Core or to Q-SYS Designer running in Emulate mode (press F6 in Designer), over the QRC protocol (TCP). For a local emulator use host "127.0.0.1" and port 1710. Must be called before any other tool.

allow_live_writes.description: Permit write tools against a LIVE (non-emulator) Core. Default false: writes are refused unless the target reports IsEmulator=true. Set true only when the user has explicitly approved changing a real system.

host.description: Core IP/hostname, or 127.0.0.1 for a local Designer emulator

password.description: Password, if the design requires authentication

reconnect.description: Auto-reconnect on a dropped socket (Core restart, network blip), replaying change-group registrations so polling resumes. Default true.

user.description: Username, if the design requires authentication

name: qsys_connect
title: Connect to Q-SYS
